title: 第5章 变异的三针花第6章 好友王冕的出谋划策
content_zh:
韩风停住了脚步，扭头看向小狐狸，缓缓开口道，
“我……们？”
“不然呢？”
“你跟着我干什么？”
韩风大脸懵逼。
“那我去哪？”
小狐狸小脸懵逼。
“你回你家去啊。”
“我哪有家啊，我一直都是东躲西藏的啊，害怕被人看见，被人抓走当灵宠啊。
难得遇见个对我没有恶意，还愿意给我灵石吃的大冤……好心人，我当然不走了啊。”
“你刚刚是不是说漏了什么？”
韩风满脸狐疑。
“没有啊，你听错了。”
小狐狸满脸认真。
“哦，你那么厉害，又是吃灵石又是炼尸体的，为什么会怕人类啊？”
“因为我没有修为啊。”
“你没有修为，为什么要吃灵气啊？”
“不吃灵气我会饿啊，你放心，我很好养活的，好几天吃一块灵石就够了。”
韩风想了想，没有修为，等于没有威胁，而且还是个处理尸体的小帮手，好像还不错，以后养养花草养养宠物，好像还不错。
“那行吧，你跟我来吧。”

回到屋子里，韩风脱掉鞋子，往床上一躺，便准备睡觉。
小狐狸也跳到了床尾，问道，
“喂，你叫什么名字呀？”
“我叫韩风。”
“你为什么不杀了我，或者逼着我签订契约，让我给你当奴隶呢？”
“我懒。”
……
一夜睡的很香，第二天上午，韩风才起床，迷迷糊糊的洗把脸，然后便来到院子里，准备躺到躺椅上晒太阳。
他每天都是这样的，除了照料草药外，其他的时间，都是在躺椅上度过。
田园生活，躺平无忧。
接着，他便看到了，躺椅上，一只小狐狸四仰八叉的躺在躺椅上，晒着太阳，十分舒服。
content_en:
Han Feng stopped, turned to look at the little fox, and slowly said,
"We...we?"
"What if?"
"Why are you following me?"
Han Feng was confused.
"Then where should I go?"
The little fox looked confused.
"You go back to your home."
"How can I have a home? I've been hiding here and there. I'm afraid of being seen and taken away as a spiritual pet.
It's rare to meet a kind-hearted person who has no ill intentions towards me and is willing to give me spiritual stones to eat my injustice... Of course I won't leave. "
"Did you just miss something?"
Han Feng looked suspicious.
"No, you heard wrong."
The little fox looked serious.
"Oh, you are so powerful. You eat spiritual stones and refine corpses. Why are you afraid of humans?"
"Because I have no cultivation level."
"You have no cultivation, why do you need to eat spiritual energy?"
"I will be hungry if I don't eat spiritual energy. Don't worry, I can feed myself very well. One spiritual stone will be enough for several days."
Han Feng thought for a while, he didn't have any cultivation, which meant he had no threat, and he was also a little helper for disposing of corpses, which seemed pretty good. In the future, he could raise flowers, plants, and pets, which seemed pretty good.
"Okay then, come with me."
Back in the house, Han Feng took off his shoes, lay down on the bed, and got ready to sleep.
The little fox also jumped to the end of the bed and asked,
"Hey, what's your name?"
"My name is Han Feng."
"Why don't you kill me, or force me to sign a contract and make me your slave?"
"I'm lazy."
…
After a good night's sleep, Han Feng got up in the morning of the next day, washed his face in a daze, and then went to the yard to lie down on the deck chair and bask in the sun.
He does this every day. Apart from taking care of the herbs, he spends the rest of his time on the recliner.
Pastoral life, lie down and have no worries.
Then, he saw a little fox lying on the recliner, basking in the sun and feeling very comfortable.
